title: 藏经阁残简 第五章 微光藏锋蝼蚁难欺藏经阁残简 第六章管事登门假意恭顺藏锋芒
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
夜色如墨，青云仙宗后山焚书台周遭夜风凛冽。
孤灯一盏悬于廊下，灯火昏黄摇曳，将沈砚清瘦的影子拉得极长。
满院堆积的废简错落整齐，木质竹卷在夜风中微微发凉，空气里依旧萦绕着陈旧墨香与朽木气息。
方才离去的两名外门弟子嘲讽言语尚未消散，沈砚静立原地，面色平静无波，心底早已无半分三年来的隐忍退让。
从前无修为、无道基、无依仗，人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，不得不忍。
如今残简道藏入神魂，道基回暖，灵气复涌，凝气三层修为稳稳扎根经脉，他早已不是那个任人践踏的废人。
隐忍，是蓄势。
绝非懦弱。
沈砚抬步，抬手抱起一摞厚重竹简。
往日他搬运这般重量，经脉干涩、灵气不济，搬上数趟便会气血翻涌、身心疲累。
可今夜，手臂沉稳有力，体内灵气周行不息，温润道韵滋养四肢百骸，举重若轻，步履平稳从容。
他默然向着焚书台走去。
山道幽静，树影婆娑。
就在他行至半途，两道身影再度从侧旁林道转出，拦在山路正中。
正是方才那两名外门弟子。
二人并未离去，而是特意折返，守在此处，摆明了是故意来找茬消遣。
左边圆脸弟子抱着双臂，满脸戏谑：“沈砚，干活挺快啊，真打算连夜把这些破烂搬完？”
右侧瘦高弟子眼神轻蔑，步步逼近：“刘管事交代，你道基残缺，修行无望，本该多受磨砺。今夜夜色正好，我俩陪你练练手脚，也算带你活动筋骨。”
话语轻浮，带着赤裸裸的欺凌之意。
在他们看来，沈砚三年废人，一身修为尽废，别说反抗，就连站稳都勉强。

平日里宗门弟子大多懒得刻意欺辱此人，可今夜夜深无人，正好拿昔日天才取乐，既可肆意折辱，又能在刘管事面前落个“督促杂役劳作”的人情，一举两得。
瘦高弟子上前一步，抬手便随意推向沈砚肩头，力道暗藏凝气四层修为，打算直接将他推倒在地，摔得满身尘土。
“跪下赔个不是，今晚我们便不让你通宵搬书，如何？”
风止影静。
面对骤然袭来的手掌，沈砚双目未抬，神色分毫不变。
三年前，他或许会被这一掌推得踉跄倒地，狼狈不堪。
但此刻，体内灵气瞬间流转肩臂，经脉通畅，道韵护体。
就在对方手掌即将触碰到衣衫的刹那，沈砚手腕微抬，动作轻描淡写，不疾不徐。
看似随意一格。
砰！
一声低沉闷响。
看似轻飘飘的格挡，却裹挟着精纯凝练的文道灵气。
瘦高弟子只觉一股柔和却无比坚韧的力量骤然反弹而来，手臂瞬间发麻，整条经脉一阵滞涩，脚下重心彻底失守！
他惊呼一声，身形踉跄后退三步，脚下打滑，一屁股狠狠摔在冰冷石阶之上，疼得龇牙咧嘴，满脸错愕。
“你——！”
他猛地抬头，满眼难以置信，死死盯着身前的沈砚。
一个道基破碎三年的废人，怎么可能挡下他凝气四层的一掌？
旁边圆脸弟子脸上的戏谑笑意瞬间僵住，眼神骤然凝重，惊疑不定地打量着沈砚。
夜色灯下，少年依旧是那一身洗旧灰白的杂役长袍，身形清瘦，眉眼沉静，看似依旧平凡无奇。
可那股从容不迫的气度，绝非往日那个唯唯诺诺、逆来顺受的废役所有。

沈砚终于抬眸，目光清淡扫过二人。
声音不高，却带着一种久居书阁、沉淀岁月的沉稳冷意：
“夜深路滑，动手之前，最好看清对手。”
content_en:
The night is dark, and the night wind is biting around the book-burning platform in the back mountain of Qingyun Immortal Sect.
A lone lamp hung in the corridor, its dim light swaying, making Shen Yan's thin shadow extremely long.
The abandoned slips piled up all over the courtyard are scattered and neatly arranged. The wooden bamboo rolls are slightly cool in the night breeze, and the scent of old ink and rotten wood still lingers in the air.
The taunting words of the two outer disciples who had just left had not yet dissipated. Shen Yan stood quietly on the spot, his face calm and calm, and the forbearance and retreat of the past three years were no longer in his heart.
In the past, I had no cultivation, no Dao foundation, and no support. I was a slave, and I had no choice but to endure it.
Now that the broken Jian Dao has been hidden in his soul, his Dao foundation has warmed up, his spiritual energy has surged again, and his third-level cultivation of Qi Condensation has firmly taken root in his meridians. He is no longer the useless person who can be trampled upon by others.
To be patient is to gain momentum.
Not cowardly.
Shen Yan stepped forward and raised his hand to pick up a stack of thick bamboo slips.
In the past, when he carried such a heavy weight, his meridians were dry and his spiritual energy was weak. After carrying it for a few times, his energy and blood would surge, and he would become physically and mentally exhausted.
But tonight, my arms are steady and strong, the spiritual energy in my body circulates endlessly, the warm Taoist rhythm nourishes my limbs, I lift weights lightly, and I walk smoothly and calmly.
He walked silently towards the book-burning table.
The mountain road is quiet and the shadows of the trees are dancing.
Just as he was halfway through, two figures turned out from the side forest road again and blocked the middle of the mountain road.
It was the two outer disciples just now.
The two of them did not leave, but deliberately turned back and stayed here, making it clear that they were deliberately looking for trouble for fun.
The round-faced disciple on the left crossed his arms and said jokingly: "Shen Yan, you work very fast. Do you really plan to move all these junk overnight?"
The tall and thin disciple on the right looked contemptuously and approached step by step: "Guanshi Liu explained that your Dao foundation is incomplete and your cultivation is hopeless. You should have been trained more. It's a good night tonight. We will practice your hands and feet with you, and we can help you stretch your muscles."
The words were frivolous, with a hint of naked bullying.
In their opinion, Shen Yan has been useless for three years, and his cultivation has been completely ruined. He can barely stand still, let alone resist.
Normally, most disciples of the sect are too lazy to deliberately humiliate this person, but tonight, when there is no one around, it is a good time to take advantage of the former genius. They can not only humiliate him wantonly, but also gain the favor of "supervising the handymen to work" in front of Manager Liu, killing two birds with one stone.
The tall and thin disciple took a step forward, raised his hand and pushed it to Shen Yan's shoulder at will. His strength was hidden at the fourth level of Qi Condensation, and he planned to push him to the ground directly, leaving him covered with dust.
"Kneel down and apologize. We won't let you move books all night tonight. How about that?"
The wind stopped and the shadows were still.
Facing the sudden attack of palms, Shen Yan did not raise his eyes, his expression unchanged.
Three years ago, he might have been pushed to the ground by this palm and fell to the ground in a miserable state.
But at this moment, the spiritual energy in the body instantly flows through the shoulders and arms, the meridians are unobstructed, and the Taoist charm protects the body.
Just when the opponent's palm was about to touch his clothes, Shen Yan raised his wrist slightly, his movements gentle and slow.
Seems like a random pattern.
Bang!
A low muffled sound.
It looks like a light block, but it is wrapped in a pure and concise literary aura.
The tall and thin disciple felt a soft but extremely tough force suddenly rebound. His arms instantly became numb, his entire meridians became stagnant, and his center of gravity completely lost control!
He exclaimed, staggered back three steps, his feet slipped, and he fell hard on the cold stone steps. He grimaced in pain and had a look of shock on his face.
"You-!"
He raised his head suddenly, eyes full of disbelief, staring at Shen Yan in front of him.
How could a cripple whose Daoji had been broken for three years block a palm from his fourth level of Qi Condensation?
The joking smile on the face of the round-faced disciple next to him froze for an instant, his eyes suddenly became serious, and he looked at Shen Yan in surprise and uncertainty.
Under the night lights, the young man was still wearing the old washed gray robe of a handyman. He was thin, with calm eyebrows, and he still looked ordinary.
But that calm and unhurried demeanor is definitely not that of the obedient and resigned useless servant in the past.
Shen Yan finally raised his eyes and glanced at the two of them.
The voice is not high, but it carriesThere is a calm and cold feeling that has been settled in the library for a long time:
"The road is slippery late at night. It's best to see your opponent clearly before taking action."
